r.경제 체제: Open market economy · multinationals' pharmaceuticals and software
r.주식시장 시가총액: $110.2 billion, 28% of GDP (2018, listed domestic companies)
r.Big Mac index: $7.08 for a Big Mac, 14% above the US price of $6.22 (Jul 2026, The Economist, euro-area average)
r.Consumer price level: 102% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.주요 수출품: Pharmaceuticals 33%, Organic chemicals 28%, Precision and medical instruments 8%, Electronics, electrical equipment 6%, Machinery, computers 5% (2025, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: Cars 34%, Computer parts 28%, Organic chemicals 14%, Electronics, electrical equipment 6% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Pharmaceuticals 26%, Vaccines, blood products 24%, Other precision and medical instruments 18%, Medical devices 8% (2025, share of value)
r.한국과 맺은 FTA: Korea-EU FTA (provisionally applied 2011, fully in force 2015)
r.정치 구도: A parliamentary system in which two centrist parties have led governments in turn or together.

t.why: Low corporate tax has drawn the European headquarters of many US tech and pharmaceutical companies. It maintains military neutrality.
t.rel: It shares an island with the UK and borders Northern Ireland. It keeps military neutrality and has not joined NATO, and within the EU it hosts many US companies' European headquarters.
t.know: The potato famine once sharply reduced its population, and a very large Irish diaspora lives abroad.
t.etext: Low corporate tax drew the European headquarters and factories of US tech and pharmaceutical companies, so exports of pharmaceuticals, medical devices and software are huge. The country's economic figures swing with the results of a few big companies.
